title: Solar cold store for 1 tonne at 4-10 C
problem_restatement: Provide solar-only power with day-night autonomy to keep 1 tonne of produce at 4-10 C in a washable racked cold box on a low-cost plinth that a cooperative can use daily.
mechanism_sentence: Sunlight makes electricity that is saved for night to run a small cooler that keeps a thick foam room with vented produce crates at 4 C to 10 C.
decisive_choices: Cap warm intake at 200 kg per day and add no warm crates on cloudy days to stay inside PV yield and battery store
Use 100 mm foam box with 2.4 kWp solar field and 5 kWh store to cover holding plus batch with about 1.4-day holding autonomy
Run steady 150 W hold with 0.4 kW daytime batch peak on a separate PV rack and sealed shaded door to keep heat gain and wind load low
open_question: Will the store stay at 4-10 C with real door openings and produce types beyond the 1.42-day no-batch hold?
transfer_line: Energy: PV array -> Battery cabinet -> DC chiller | Measured: Box air sensor -> Thermostat

assumed_constraints.constraint: sized for one full night plus cloudy-day margin
100 mm thickness for 30 K hot ambient
racking fits 2x2 m box with human reach under 1.8 m

functional_decomposition: Supply solar-only electric energy with day-night autonomy for 1 tonne cold storage
Maintain cold insulated volume for 1 tonne produce at 4-10 C with low heat gain and uniform air
House 1 tonne produce in washable vented crates with ergonomic racking, doors and cleaning for daily cooperative use
Support 1 tonne produce plus box and wind on low-cost washable plinth with lockable insulated door and PV rack using local build methods

concept.working_principle: Fixed-tilt PV array charges 48 V LiFePO4 store through MPPT to run a DC compressor chiller holding a 100 mm PU box at 4-10 C, with fan-mixed air through vented crates on low racks on a concrete plinth, loading capped to match sun and battery.

fabrication_steps.description: Cast the raised concrete base and level the washable floor for the 2.6 m square store
Bolt the steel corner frame and lock together the 100 mm foam panels for the 2 m box
Fit the 900 mm insulated door, low side racks and about 60 vented crates with air gaps
Place the six-panel solar rack apart from the box and set the battery cabinet and small cooler beside the room

risks.risk: Full-tonne pull-down energy exceeds daily PV yield and battery store
risks.mitigation: Cap warm intake at 200 kg per day and pause intake when cloudy

risks.risk: Cloudy stretch beyond 1.42-day autonomy lets box drift out of 4-10 C
risks.mitigation: Hold only with sealed door and fan mixing using produce thermal buffer and battery reserve

risks.risk: Wind gust loads panels and light box while soil must carry full weight
risks.mitigation: Keep PV rack separate from cold box and anchor box to plinth

novelty_claim: One buildable unit combining PU box plus DC chiller plus airflow plus PV-battery plus crates-racks plus plinth-frame-door for 1 tonne at 4-10 C with capped batch and no-batch cloudy rule.
